case_number: 2025 INSC 208; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 2411 OF 2025 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (C)No.943 of 2023)

parties.respondent: The Deputy Commissioner Of Income Tax

summary: Tax penalty under s.271AAA Income Tax Act, 1961; conditions for exemption mandatory; non-payment of tax and interest despite notice; undisclosed income from land transaction facilitated through MOU; search proceedings revealed ₹2.27Cr undisclosed income; penalty upheld at 10% of assessed income; HC and ITAT correctly held third condition of s.271AAA(2) unfulfilled; voluntary disclosure after search insufficient to waive penalty; final assessment order dated 15-03-2013 accepted.
legal_provisions_cited: Income Tax Act, 1961 s.271AAA(1), s.271AAA(2), s.132(4), s.260A
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment affirmed; penalty upheld.
